entries.0ae54d6e4d91f601: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥16,246 million, up 7.1% year on year. The company has only one reportable segment, “Japan,” and segment information disclosure has been omitted.
entries.13f436f2b988e5d3: The company explains that through continuous holding of original bath and sauna events that each store runs to suit local characteristics, and collaboration events with anime content and Vtubers, it has succeeded in attracting a broad customer base. It uses two brands, the large destination hot spring facility “RAKU SPA” and the super sento “Gokurakuyu”, to differentiate facility formats, and is advancing openings with a focus on company-operated stores.
entries.215564264d23faa1: Through 30 company-owned stores, the company earns admission fees and food and beverage revenue from its hot bath facilities, as well as revenue from bodywork, hair cutting, merchandise sales and others.
entries.2629e76dbbde1c51: Large-scale stay-type hot spring facility “RAKU SPA”
entries.2dea171e05928ef1: It operates hot spring facilities under the names “Gokurakuyu” and “RAKU SPA,” with a total of 40 stores (30 directly operated and 10 franchised), plus one partner store, “Hinata no Mori,” and two directly operated “RAKU CAFE” stores in a related business.
entries.36ef3db9b538544a: Revenue from food and beverage and merchandise sales at directly operated stores, etc.
entries.5fa5ed2d8ac584e5: Through 10 franchised stores, under franchise agreements, the company earns revenue from sales of products related to running super sento (public bath) facilities and royalty income from providing know-how and other services, among others.
entries.70334ae3c76914ce: It is a holding company that, through its consolidated subsidiary Gokurakuyu Co., Ltd., operates hot spring facilities under the names “Gokurakuyu” and “RAKU SPA,” running directly operated stores and franchise expansion.
entries.7991c7eb3610d454: As a related business, the company has opened 2 company-owned RAKU CAFE stores. There is also 1 partner store, Hinata no Mori.
entries.79b4192e42160270: Based on the overview of operating results in MD&A, the analysis and examination of operating results from management's perspective, and the trend of key management indicators.
entries.83c8f1050d9b3acb: The company has only one reportable segment, “Japan”, and all of its revenue of ¥16,246 million comes from the domestic hot spring business. As of June 2026, the number of stores was 54 in total: “Gokurakuyu” and “RAKU SPA” comprised 30 domestic company-operated stores, 10 franchised stores and 11 affiliated stores overseas; “RAKU CAFE” comprised two domestic company-operated stores; and partner store “Hinata no Mori” comprised one store. No single external customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue from external customers.
entries.8da8b5608e34d7bd: Its main customers are visitors who use directly operated stores and operators of franchised stores under franchise agreements, and there is no major customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue.

entries.925692a297048af8: A holding company that operates "Gokurakuyu" and "RAKU SPA" hot spring bathing facilities through direct management and franchising.
entries.a6d467b9cdf83649: Royalty income and product sales revenue from franchised stores.
entries.ab8fe96b7e2732fd: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥928 million.
entries.af891686e6b3f529: The group is rebuilding its store opening strategy, focusing store development on opening company-operated stores to establish a 60-store structure. It is focusing on strengthening the gathering of information on candidate sites for new stores and scrutinizing store opening conditions, actively considering and implementing various reviews of existing stores, such as renovations, and working to secure and develop personnel able to cope with the expansion of store numbers and operations.
entries.b357d439ec3889bd: This business operates hot bath facilities under the names “Gokurakuyu” and “RAKU SPA”. Consolidated subsidiary Gokurakuyu Co.,Ltd. handles store operations, the only reportable segment is “Japan”, and revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥16,246 million.
entries.c237e4124d65f27e: This business operates hot bath facilities under the names “Gokurakuyu” and “RAKU SPA”.
entries.d06e0e8252139aab: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 rose 7.1% year on year to ¥16,246 million, and net income attributable to owners of the parent rose 20.7% year on year to ¥928 million, setting a new all-time high that further surpassed the prior year's record, which had been the highest since listing. The company explains that full-year operation of stores opened in the prior year, continued collaboration events with anime content, Vtubers and similar, a revision of admission fees, and the opening of “RAKU SPA Station Musashi-Koganei” in December 2025 contributed to the increase in revenue.

entries.fdde2211621fbea3: Established in 1980 as Sanyō Jitsugyō Co., Ltd., the company moved to a holding company structure through a new company split in January 2017, and together with its two consolidated subsidiaries it forms the group, with 188 consolidated employees as of March 31, 2026.
